cancellations.title: Cancellations
cancellations.subtitle: See buyers' requests to cancel an order and when eBay needs your answer. Open a request to accept or decline it.

filters.search: Search cancellation ID, order ID or product…

empty.title: No cancellation requests yet
empty.description: Orders your buyers ask to cancel on eBay will appear here.

emptyFiltered.title: No requests match your filters
emptyFiltered.description: Try another tab or search term.

bucketHint.unconfirmed: eBay has not confirmed this request recently, so what is due is not shown.
bucketHint.action_overdue: The buyer is waiting — eBay's deadline for your answer has passed.
bucketHint.action_due: The buyer asked to cancel. Accept or decline before eBay's deadline.
bucketHint.answered: You answered this request. eBay is processing it — nothing more is due from you.
bucketHint.in_progress: Nothing is due from you right now.

reason.BUYER_CANCEL_OR_ADDRESS_ISSUE: Buyer cancelled or has an address problem
reason.OUT_OF_STOCK_OR_CANNOT_FULFILL: Out of stock or cannot fulfil

detail.title: Cancellation {{id}}
detail.loadFailed: This request could not be loaded
detail.loadFailedDescription: Try again in a moment, or open it on eBay.
detail.nothingToDo: Nothing is waiting for you on this request.
detail.journeyEmpty: eBay has not recorded any step yet.

approve.body: The order is cancelled and eBay refunds the buyer. This cannot be undone.

reject.body: eBay is told you decline, and the order has to be shipped.
reject.bodyWithTracking: eBay is told you decline, and the tracking number {{tracking}} is sent along. The order has to be shipped.

done.approve: Cancellation accepted. eBay will refund the buyer.

cancellations.actionsOff: In-app cancellation actions are off — answer on eBay.
cancellations.liveUnavailable: eBay could not be reached just now, so this is the last state SellerHill saw. Answers are offered once eBay answers again.

errors.actionsDisabled: In-app cancellation actions are switched off on this platform. Answer the request on eBay.
errors.actionNotAvailable: eBay no longer offers this action on the request. Refresh and check what is waiting now.
errors.suspended: Your subscription is suspended, so cancellation actions are paused. Settle the invoice on the Billing page.
errors.ebayRejected: eBay refused this action. Open the request on eBay to see why.
errors.unavailable: eBay could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.sandbox: Cancellation actions are not available on the eBay sandbox.
errors.notFound: This cancellation request was not found.
